_comment: Resolved project config for the /study-run planner. Written once by discovery so later runs skip searching. Delete this file to force re-discovery after moving or renaming files.

total_marks 175 = combined 2023_Exam + Old_Exam_Tasks, matching the exam_coverage note in progress.json.
